failed_conditions.quote: [Conclusion](https://github.com/ros2/rmw_fastrtps/issues/606#issuecomment-1188179374) is that fastrtps currently only supports 1 waitset per entity. Waitsets are created in rclcpp via Executor, and the static executor currently will recreate the waitset on every loop, which creates a race condition for fastrtps and it drops the event completely.
